description: Header file defining the Dict class and related structures for a dictionary implementation in PyTorch's ATen library, including internal classes, iterators, and type handling.
external_methods: bool operator()(const IValue& lhs, const IValue& rhs) const
bool operator==(const DictImpl& lhs, const DictImpl& rhs)

classes.name: Dict
classes.description: A pointer-like class representing a map from Key to Value, with internal shared storage and various map operations.

classes.name: DictImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation class for Dict, holding the actual map and type information.

classes.name: DictEntryRef
classes.description: Reference to an entry in the Dict, allowing access to key and value.

classes.name: DictIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing Dict entries.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Dict.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the element following the last.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the Dict is empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the Dict.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair if key does not exist.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes element(s) by iterator or key.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Returns the value associated with a key.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity for a number of elements.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if two Dicts are the same object.

calls: bool operator()(const IValue& lhs, const IValue& rhs) const
